categories.C: Breached; final close outside but within selected10%/15% full-width buffer

definitions.scoring: Complete target windows only. A wick breach counts. Final close is last bar closing at endpoint. Inside includes boundaries.
definitions.baseline: For each scored date and basis, mean/median U/D across all eligible earlier unconditioned cases at the same time. NY baseline uses same complete Asia/London/NY requirements. Same dates and same basis are paired.
definitions.error: Average of absolute upside and downside forecast errors, each divided by that day’s frozen AVR. Negative paired change is lower error than baseline. Not a trading return.
definitions.intervals: 95% circular10-day moving-block bootstrap,1000 replicates; no interval below20 cases. These remain exploratory and have no multiple-testing correction.
definitions.fit: All-history reconstruction includes self and later dates. Earlier-only excludes both. Low-count earlier forecasts are reported separately; they are not silently filled.

checks.pointScale: Model integer hundredths are exact transformations of source tenth-point ticks; no tick rounding of forecast boundaries.
